focus_areas.name: Oil Pollution Prevention
focus_areas.description: SPCC applicability, planning, inspections, secondary containment, and official federal oil pollution prevention requirements.

focus_areas.name: NPDES / Water
focus_areas.description: Federal NPDES permitting and compliance guidance for industrial stormwater and water discharges.

focus_areas.name: Hazardous Waste
focus_areas.description: Federal RCRA hazardous waste identification, management, compliance, and regulatory resources.

focus_areas.name: Superfund
focus_areas.description: CERCLA authorities, cleanup processes, liability, and the federal Superfund remediation program.

focus_areas.name: TSCA / PCBs
focus_areas.description: Federal requirements and guidance for polychlorinated biphenyl management, cleanup, and disposal.

focus_areas.name: EPCRA
focus_areas.description: Emergency planning, community right-to-know, and federal chemical reporting requirements.

recent_updates.title: EPA / Federal Resources Added
recent_updates.description: Initial federal jurisdiction launched with official EPA and eCFR resources for SPCC, NPDES, RCRA, CERCLA, TSCA/PCBs, and EPCRA programs.

documents.title: SPCC Rule Overview
documents.description: EPA overview of the Spill Prevention, Control, and Countermeasure rule, including the federal oil pollution prevention purpose, regulated facility concepts, SPCC Plan requirements, and core compliance obligations under 40 CFR Part 112.

documents.title: SPCC Applicability — Who Is Covered
documents.description: EPA applicability guide for determining whether the SPCC rule applies to a facility based on non-transportation-related operations, oil storage capacity, oil-related activities, and the reasonable expectation of discharge to navigable waters or adjoining shorelines.

documents.title: 40 CFR Part 112 — Oil Pollution Prevention
documents.description: Official eCFR regulatory text for federal Oil Pollution Prevention requirements, including SPCC Plans, Facility Response Plan provisions, secondary containment, inspections, training, and discharge reporting obligations.
documents.verification_note: Current Part 112 text was confirmed through the official eCFR API at the latest available issue date; the public browser destination uses anti-automation controls.

documents.title: Facility Owner/Operator's Guide to Oil Pollution Prevention
documents.description: Plain-language EPA SPCC guide for facility owners and operators covering applicability, oil storage, SPCC Plan development, certification, inspections, secondary containment, training, and implementation responsibilities.

documents.title: Tier I Qualified Facility SPCC Plan Template
documents.description: EPA template for eligible Tier I qualified facilities to prepare and self-certify an SPCC Plan. Useful for smaller regulated facilities that meet EPA's qualified-facility criteria.

documents.title: SPCC Secondary Containment Calculation Worksheets
documents.description: EPA worksheets and examples for documenting secondary-containment calculations for specified simplified oil-storage configurations; site-specific conditions may require a different approach.

documents.title: Industrial Stormwater Guidance
documents.description: EPA industrial stormwater guidance hub for NPDES stormwater requirements, regulated industrial activities, permitting resources, sector-specific guidance, and SWPPP-related compliance assistance.

documents.title: Learn the Basics of Hazardous Waste
documents.description: EPA overview of the Resource Conservation and Recovery Act hazardous waste program, including waste identification, generator requirements, transportation, treatment, storage, disposal, and cradle-to-grave management concepts.

documents.title: Superfund: CERCLA Overview
documents.description: EPA overview of CERCLA and the Superfund cleanup program, including contaminated site response authorities, cleanup process concepts, liability framework, and federal site remediation program structure.

documents.title: Learn About Polychlorinated Biphenyls (PCBs)
documents.description: EPA resource explaining PCBs under TSCA, including PCB uses, health and environmental concerns, cleanup and disposal context, and federal PCB regulatory program information.

documents.title: What Is EPCRA?
documents.description: EPA overview of the Emergency Planning and Community Right-to-Know Act, including emergency planning, chemical inventory reporting, toxic release reporting, and public access to chemical hazard information.

documents.title: All Appropriate Inquiries
documents.description: EPA's primary resource for the federal All Appropriate Inquiries framework, including the final rule and official supporting materials relevant to environmental due diligence.

documents.title: Low-Flow (Minimal Drawdown) Ground-Water Sampling Procedures
documents.description: EPA technical guidance on low-flow groundwater sampling procedures intended to minimize drawdown and disturbance during sample collection.

documents.title: RCRAInfo Industry Applications
documents.description: EPA's professional system for regulated hazardous waste sites to submit and maintain site notifications through myRCRAid, manage e-Manifest records, and prepare applicable Biennial Reports.

documents.title: Is My Facility a "Qualified Facility" under the SPCC Rule?
documents.description: EPA guidance describing the Tier I and Tier II qualified-facility criteria and the associated SPCC Plan certification options.

documents.title: Oil Discharge Reporting Requirements
documents.description: EPA's current gateway to federal oil-discharge reporting requirements under 40 CFR Parts 110 and 112, including National Response Center and EPA reporting considerations.
documents.verification_note: EPA continues to publish the older supporting fact-sheet content on its current reporting page, last updated November 18, 2025; no express replacement was identified.

documents.title: Pretreatment Standards and Requirements — Categorical Pretreatment Standards
documents.description: EPA's authoritative gateway to national categorical pretreatment standards and industry-specific effluent guidelines applicable to qualifying indirect industrial dischargers.

documents.title: Criteria for the Definition of Solid Waste and Solid and Hazardous Waste Exclusions
documents.description: EPA guidance on the federal definition of solid waste and exclusions from solid- and hazardous-waste regulation, including links to the governing federal framework.

documents.title: Defining Hazardous Waste: Listed, Characteristic and Mixed Radiological Wastes
documents.description: EPA guidance on the federal hazardous-waste identification framework, including listed, characteristic, and mixed radiological wastes.

documents.title: Hazardous Waste Test Methods / SW-846
documents.description: EPA's current compendium of sampling, preparation, analytical, and quality-assurance methods used to support hazardous-waste and other environmental evaluations.

documents.title: Technical Guide for Assessing and Mitigating the Vapor Intrusion Pathway from Subsurface Vapor Sources to Indoor Air
documents.description: EPA's maintained gateway to the final technical guide and current errata for evaluating the vapor intrusion pathway from subsurface vapor sources to indoor air.
documents.verification_note: The maintained EPA gateway resolves without redirect or archive warning and links the June 2015 final technical guide and October 2016 errata. No superseding general EPA vapor-intrusion technical guide was identified during final QA.
